say:2:1223309001:0.text: Is that you, Aron? I must say, you're pretty slick. You planted that fly there, didn't you?
say:2:1223309001:0.source_cn: 是阿隆啊？小动作还挺熟练，苍蝇是你粘的吧。

say:3:1223309002:0.text: Say no more! I could have put you out of business from day one if it weren't for your helpers!
say:3:1223309002:0.source_cn: 少废话！要不是你们有帮手，今天让你们从开业变破产！

say:4:1223309003:0.text: ...Renata sent you here, right? Did you steal our goods too?
say:4:1223309003:0.source_cn: ……是雷纳塔让你们来的吧。货也是你们劫的？

say:5:1223309004:0.text: Hmph, I'd have kicked you spineless sea slugs out of Rustport already if it wasn't for these meddling hamsters and their magister!
say:5:1223309004:0.source_cn: 嘁，要不是这碍事的魔法师，今天我要你们这帮软皮蛇消失在...
say:5:1223309004:0.male: Hmph, I'd have kicked you spineless sea slugs out of Rustport already if it wasn't for these meddling hamsters and their magister!
say:5:1223309004:0.female: Hmph, I'd have kicked you spineless sea slugs out of Rustport already if it wasn't for these meddling hamsters and their magister!

say:8:1223309005:1.text: Who are you calling spineless sea slugs?!
say:8:1223309005:1.source_cn: 哈！？原来是你们？你叫谁软皮蛇？！

say:9:1223309006:1.text: Oh? Surprise, surprise. I remember you looked like a scared octopus when we raided your goods! I hope you didn't ink yourself! Ha!
say:9:1223309006:1.source_cn: 喔？劫车时你被吓的跟狗一样，现在吼这么大声？

say:11:1223309008:1.text: We'll be back, sea slugs! Hahaha...
say:11:1223309008:1.source_cn: 我们还会来的！软皮蛇们！哈哈哈……
